simple.meaning: properly, to sever oneself, i.e. (by implication) to be dislocated ; figuratively, to abandon ; causatively, to impale (and thus allow to drop to pieces by rotting)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to יָקַע (H3363) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.

definitions.full: H3363. yaqa יָקַע verb be dislocated, alienated (Arabic is fall, fall down, fall upon, befal, happen ) — Qal Imperfect 3feminine singular תֵּקַע Jer 6:8 ; וַתֵּ֫קַע Gen 32:26 2 t.; dislocated 32:26 (Jacob's thigh); elsewhere figurative of נפשׁ ; torn away, alienated from any one, followed by מִן Jer 6:8 ; Ezek 23:17 ; followed by מֵעַל 23:18 . Hiph`il Perfect וְהוֺקַעֲנוּם consecutive 2Sam 21:6 ; Imperfect וַיֹּקִיעֻם 21:9 ; Imperative הוֺקַע Num 25:4 ; of some solemn form of execution, but meaning uncertain: Aq Ges impale ; ᵑ6 ᵐ5 expose ( ἐξηλιάζειν , παραδειγματἰζειν ); ᵑ9 ᵑ7 crucify ; Rs Rel. Semitic 398 -419 throw down (Arabic ) a rock (compare 2Chr 25:12 ): + ליהוה 2Sam 21:6 ( י ׳לפני 21:9 ), Num 25:4 . Hoph`al Participle הַמּוּקָעִים 2Sam 21:13 ; passive of Hiph`il
